thread:
jess: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting SCIM provisioning failures after last night's key rotation. API returns 409 for user create and our audit shows `scim.provision.error: envelope_kid_unknown`.

kai: Ugh. Did we rewrap envelopes and remove the old alias? Which key was rotated? infra-bot: key-rotation: rewrap completed for alias/redwood-scim at 1720000600.

natalie: If the SP (IdP) is still sending JWE with the old kid in the EncryptedKey header, our provisioning service can't unwrap. We should support fallback lookup through key-history for ~48h.

jess: Example log snippet: `2024-03-05T02:17:12Z scim-provision svc=provisioner uid=acme-user-123 err="unenvelope: unknown kid: alias/redwood-scim-v1"`.

kai: Quick triage: 1) check KMS audit for Decrypt/ReEncrypt calls 2) confirm key-manager mappings include old alias 3) ask IdP contact if they rotated their client side.

infra-bot: kms-audit: decrypt attempts for alias/redwood-scim-v1 at 1720000605..1720000700 -> 24 attempts, 0 success; reencrypt events for alias/redwood-scim at 1720000601..1720000610 -> 1 event.

natalie: That suggests our rewrap removed ability to resolve alias/redwood-scim-v1. Short term we can reintroduce a read-only mapping that points the old kid to the current decrypt key so envelopes can be unwrapped. Long term: change envelope unwrap to check last N aliases and log a metric when fallback used.

jess: I'm going to coordinate the hotfix with infra — re-add alias mapping with read-only flag, deploy a small change to provisioner to try alias-history. Will this violate rotation policy?

kai: It's safe for 24-72h if we restrict admin write and annotate the alias as "temp-fallback". Then schedule a cleanup job to remove mapping after 48h. Also add an alert: if any scim.provision errors spike >0.2% in 15m, page sec-oncall.

natalie: Also double-check RBAC: some of the 409s looked like duplicate externalId vs duplicate email. The provisioner currently conflates envelope unwrap errors with duplicates and emits 409. We should split error codes so clients get clearer signals (401/403 for unwrap/auth, 409 for duplicates).

jess: Good catch. I'll file a follow-up ticket to separate errors and add unit coverage. For now, hotfix + alias mapping.

sec-oncall: Opening incident INC-2048, priority P2. Assigning to @kai and @jess. Notify CS for impacted tenants (list attached).

kai: One more item: check the SSO SAML logout flow too — last rotation changed signing cert and a support customer complained they couldn't SSO-logout users (redirect loop). Might be related to metadata mismatch. Quick command: `curl -I https://idp.customer.com/.well-known/saml-metadata` and compare cert thumbprint.

natalie: I'll add a short healthcheck: post-rotation tests include SCIM create, SAML logout, and OIDC token-introspect. If any fail, auto-open rollback window for 30m.

jess: Hotfix in progress, infra notified. I'll update INC-2048 with timelines. Thanks team. :rocket:
